@graph.name: NigeriaStack
@graph.description: NigeriaStack is an independent, Nigerian-designed, whole-of-economy open technical specification and conformance commons for digital interoperability, versioned RFCs, schemas and reference implementation guidance.
@graph.disambiguatingDescription: Institutionally distinct from India Stack, GovStack, X-Road, Diia and Nigerian statutory agencies; it does not act as a government regulator, payment processor or official registry.
